promise: Direct the image, choose the draft, and refine the actual file.
audience: People and agents creating or refining visual assets with explicit artifact review.
trigger: Use when directing an image, choosing and refining concrete drafts, delivering an artifact pack, or converting image and ASCII art.

modes.name: Fast
modes.when: One clear low-risk image or edit with an available tool.
modes.output: One concrete file with technical checks and visual review at the capability actually available.

modes.name: Guided
modes.when: One meaningful creative or technical ambiguity.
modes.output: Focused direction or parameter judgment, then a checked draft.

modes.name: Studio
modes.when: A campaign, batch, reference asset, costly output, or consequential edit needs review.
modes.output: Approved brief/cost plan, selected artifacts, anchored refinements, and final artifact pack.

modes.name: ASCII
modes.when: The intended artifact is characters or a rasterized text composition.
modes.output: A local luminance-mapped text/HTML artifact or rasterization with no generation required when a source exists.

examples.title: The approved cup stays the approved cup
examples.brief: A fictional studio chooses draft cup-A, then requests a small label correction.
examples.before: Rerun the same prompt at higher quality and deliver the resulting different composition as the approved image.
examples.after: Edit cup-A or its last accepted descendant, retain parent/hash lineage, show the new exact file, and keep visual QA pending if the model cannot see its pixels.
examples.why: Approval belongs to a concrete artifact. Reusing a prompt creates a new candidate.

boundaries: Installing the portable method starts no service, uploads no image, and calls no paid provider.
The native adapter speaks only MCP to an independently installed server. It imports no provider-server package and searches no sibling checkout.
Model names, costs, sizes, safety behavior, and tool arguments must be checked against live schemas and current authoritative provider documentation.
Studio approval and draft selection are existing workflow gates. Preserve prior user approvals at their exact scope.

marketing.headline: Take the image from brief to chosen file.
marketing.lead: A creative production skill for images and ASCII art. Clarify the brief, review concrete drafts and refine the file you actually chose, with the checks and delivery details needed to use it.

benefits.title: Use the right amount of process
benefits.body: Fast handles a clear small task; Guided resolves an ambiguity; Studio supports deliberate draft selection and refinement.

benefits.title: Preserve what you approved
benefits.body: Anchor edits to the selected artifact and keep accepted and rejected branches traceable.

benefits.title: Receive a usable artifact pack
benefits.body: Deliver the exact file with dimensions, alt text, literal text, lineage and an honest visual-review state.

walkthrough.title: Direct the brief
walkthrough.detail: Name intended use, subject, dimensions, preserve constraints, references and acceptance criteria.

walkthrough.title: Choose and refine
walkthrough.detail: Review actual drafts, select one and edit its accepted descendant instead of silently creating a replacement.

walkthrough.title: Inspect and deliver
walkthrough.detail: Check the exact bytes and pixels when available, then deliver the file, preview and manifest.

use_when: You need a visual asset with a specific brief and review path.
An approved image needs a small correction without losing its composition.
You want a local image-to-ASCII conversion without generation.
not_for: An included image provider, free generation quota or an automatic claim of authenticity.
Visual approval inferred from a filename, a successful write or a prompt.
marketing.quickstart_prompt: Use Imagen Studio in Guided mode to prepare a fictional product-card illustration. It needs a 4:3 composition, room for a heading and no text inside the image. Draft the brief and acceptance checks first; show the provider and cost before any generation.

install_notes: Requires Git and Python 3.11+ for the repository installer. The portable method itself can be read by a compatible agent without a service or provider account.
The destination is a skills-parent folder. Use the discovery path supported by your agent; ~/.agents/skills is an example, not a universal host setting.
Keep the complete installed folder, references and license together. Identical reinstall is safe; conflicts are refused. A deliberate --replace keeps a dated backup.
